snippet.title: Farm Ricochet — Official Trailer | The farming game where every ricochet becomes a harvest
snippet.description:
Farm Ricochet — Official Trailer | The farming game where every ricochet becomes a harvest
Play free now at https://farmricochet.com - no download, in your browser on PC and phone.

Heroes that bounce on their own. Hit a crop, harvest. Hit a demon, damage. Nine hero classes, five rarities, five biomes, bosses, a PvP arena where you pull, aim and release, clans of up to 100 farmers and a global chat in five languages, auto-translated.

The sky split without warning over Ricochet Farm. Turn the old mill, light the signal and call the Heroes' Legion. As long as one hero stands, this farm will not fall to the demons.

Free to play. Sign in with Google and your progress is saved to your account. Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Chinese and Japanese.

Discord: https://discord.gg/4xzvpvZmDn
X: https://x.com/farmricochet

#FarmRicochet #indiegame #browsergame #farming #pinball
